text: {"lessons":["Taking profits on Stock A and D felt satisfying, but I should avoid selling just because a position is in the green; decisions should reflect current prospects and portfolio balance.","Selling Stock E at a loss was painful, but holding solely to avoid realizing a loss can be costly. I should reassess the investment rather than anchor on my average cost.","My account value fell after rising, and frequent monitoring can invite reactive trades. I should use a consistent, risk-aware plan and diversify instead of overreacting to short-term moves."]}
